title: E-Reader | Origami Penguin
heading: E-Reader
description: Open EPUB, PDF, Word and text files in a private browser reading window.
body:
Open a book or document from your device. Files stay in your browser.

Open separately

Drop a file anywhere in this reading window.

Choose a document to start reading.

Supported files EPUB, PDF, Word (.docx), HTML, plain text, Markdown, CSV, JSON, and common images up to 80 MB. EPUB, Word and HTML use a simplified reading view. Markdown and CSV open as text. PDF controls depend on your browser. DRM-protected books and older .doc files are unsupported.
styles: #reader{background:#fffdf9;border:1px solid #c4d4cf;border-radius:14px;padding:clamp(.8rem,3vw,1.5rem);margin:1.3rem 0;color:#223947}#reader [hidden]{display:none}.reader-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.7rem}.reader-toolbar label{font-weight:700}.reader-toolbar button,.reader-toolbar input::file-selector-button{font:inherit;padding:.55rem .75rem;border:1px solid #57766d;border-radius:6px;background:#edf5f0;color:#213f38;cursor:pointer}#reader-file{font:inherit;max-width:100%}.reader-drop{border:2px dashed #99b3a8;padding:.75rem;text-align:center;border-radius:8px}#reader-status{overflow-wrap:anywhere}#reader-output{overflow:auto;min-height:18rem;max-height:70vh;padding:clamp(.7rem,3vw,2rem);border:1px solid #d1ddd6;border-radius:8px;background:white;line-height:1.7;overflow-wrap:anywhere}#reader-output pre{white-space:pre-wrap}#reader-output img{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;margin:auto}#reader-output.reader-media{padding:0}#reader-output iframe{width:100%;height:66vh;min-height:18rem;display:block;border:0}#reader.reader-expanded{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1000;margin:0;border-radius:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:auto}#reader.reader-expanded #reader-output{flex:1;max-height:none}#reader.reader-expanded iframe{height:100%}.reader-lock{overflow:hidden}
